You are implementing Task 2: `--site` on the CLI entries.

## Task Description

Read your task brief first: `/Users/akamaotto/code/icubefarm/sponsor-workspace-prototype/.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-20-pan-african-org-site-and-video/task-2-brief.md`

It contains the full task text from the plan, with the exact code and test cases to use verbatim.

## Context

Work from: `/Users/akamaotto/code/icubefarm/sponsor-workspace-prototype` (branch `feat/pan-african-org`)

This repo hosts a static multi-locale prototype. Today there is ONE site: English at the repo root with generated `/fr` and `/es` beside it. We are adding a SECOND site at `pan-african-org/`, whose English lives in `pan-african-org/en/`. This task makes the four CLI tools able to target either site.

### What Task 1 already did (you depend on it)

`tools/build-i18n.js` now has an `englishDir` option threaded all the way through:
`rewriteToggleLinks(html, locale, pageName, englishDir = null)` → `rewriteLanguageToggle(html, locale, pageName, catalog, dntSet, englishDir = null)` → `translateHtml(html, {..., englishDir})` → `buildAll({..., englishDir})`.

Your `resolveSite()` returns `englishDir`, and the `build-i18n.js` CLI runner must pass it into `buildAll` — that connection is what makes the new site's toggles point at `../en/<page>`.

### Verified facts you can rely on

- The brief changes page discovery from the hardcoded `DEFAULT_PROTOTYPE_PAGES` to reading `*.html` from the source directory. I have already verified these are identical for the ministry root: 11 files, same sorted list. So this change is safe — but it is the single most likely place this task could regress the frozen site, so treat Step 6 as the real gate.
- `fs` and `path` are already required at the top of `tools/build-i18n.js`.
- `tools/validate-catalogs.js` already accepts a directory argument and needs **no change** — `node tools/validate-catalogs.js pan-african-org/i18n` works today. Do not modify it.
- `tools/check-i18n.js` already has an arg-parsing loop with `--src`, `--gen`, `--i18n`, `--pages`, `--locales`, `--silent`. Your `--site` branch joins that existing if/else chain as the brief shows.

### One thing to check before you write it

The brief has `extract-i18n.js` and `check-i18n.js` do `require('./build-i18n.js')` to get `resolveSite`. Confirm `build-i18n.js` does not require either of those files back — a cycle would be a real problem. If a cycle exists, report it rather than working around it silently.

## Critical constraint — the ministry site is frozen

No file at the repo root, in `/fr`, `/es`, or `tutorial-video{,-fr,-es}/` may change. With no `--site` flag, every tool must behave exactly as it does today. Brief Step 6 is the proof and is mandatory: run the full suite, rebuild both the site and both video locales, and confirm `git status --porcelain fr/ es/ tutorial-video-fr/ tutorial-video-es/` prints **nothing**.

Note: `tutorial-video/snapshots/` is untracked scratch that already exists — ignore it. Only tracked-file changes matter.

## A sequencing note

Brief Step 2 creates `pan-african-org/en/` and `pan-african-org/i18n/` with `.gitkeep` files, because `resolveSite` decides the `en/` branch by `fs.existsSync` at call time and the test needs that directory to exist. Task 3 will remove the `en/.gitkeep` when it writes real pages there. Create them as the brief says.

## Report

Write your full report to:
`/Users/akamaotto/code/icubefarm/sponsor-workspace-prototype/.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-20-pan-african-org-site-and-video/task-2-report.md`

Include TDD evidence (RED command + failing output + why that failure was expected; GREEN command + passing output) and the exact output of the Step 6 ministry-freeze check.

Then reply with ONLY (under 15 lines): Status, commits (short SHA + subject), a one-line test summary, any concerns, and the report file path.

# Task 2 Report: `--site` on the CLI entries

## Status: Complete

Commit: `a98e285` — `feat(i18n): add --site flag for multi-site builds`
Branch: `feat/pan-african-org`
Parent: `8d66215` (Task 1 — `englishDir` threading)

## Cycle check (pre-flight)

Confirmed `tools/build-i18n.js` requires only `node:fs` and `node:path` — it does
not require `extract-i18n.js` or `check-i18n.js`. `extract-i18n.js` and
`check-i18n.js` both require `./build-i18n.js` for `resolveSite`
(and `check-i18n.js` also requires `extract-i18n.js` for
`loadDoNotTranslate`/`isTranslatable`, unchanged from before this task). No
cycle exists.

## TDD evidence

### RED

Command:
```
node --test tests/site-config.test.js
```

Ran after appending the three `resolveSite` tests from the brief to
`tests/site-config.test.js` (Step 1) and creating `pan-african-org/en/` and
`pan-african-org/i18n/` with `.gitkeep` files (Step 2), but before touching
`tools/build-i18n.js`.

Output (relevant part):
```
✔ without englishDir, English stays at the site root (ministry behaviour) (0.748959ms)
✔ with englishDir, English is a sibling directory (0.279958ms)
✔ with englishDir, the es page links back through ../en/ (0.070375ms)
✔ with englishDir, an en page reaches siblings through ../ (0.06725ms)
✔ the active segment still tracks the locale when englishDir is set (0.551125ms)
✖ no --site resolves to repo root with no englishDir (0.1085ms)
✖ --site with an en/ subdirectory sources from it (0.0575ms)
✖ --site without an en/ subdirectory sources from the site root (0.047584ms)
ℹ tests 8
ℹ pass 5
ℹ fail 3

✖ failing tests:
  TypeError: resolveSite is not a function
      at TestContext.<anonymous> (tests/site-config.test.js:55:13)
  ... (same error for all 3 new tests)
```

This is the expected failure: `resolveSite` did not exist yet on
`module.exports` of `tools/build-i18n.js`, so `require('../tools/build-i18n.js').resolveSite`
was `undefined` and calling it threw `TypeError: resolveSite is not a
function`. The 5 pre-existing `rewriteToggleLinks` tests in the same file
(carried over from Task 1) continued to pass, confirming the failure was
isolated to the new feature, not a regression.

### GREEN

Implemented `resolveSite(args, cwd = process.cwd())` in `tools/build-i18n.js`
verbatim per the brief (Step 4), exported it from `module.exports`, and
replaced the CLI runner body to use it (page discovery now reads `*.html`
from `srcDir` instead of the hardcoded `DEFAULT_PROTOTYPE_PAGES` list).

Command:
```
node --test tests/site-config.test.js
```

Output:
```
✔ without englishDir, English stays at the site root (ministry behaviour) (0.759917ms)
✔ with englishDir, English is a sibling directory (0.28875ms)
✔ with englishDir, the es page links back through ../en/ (0.068042ms)
✔ with englishDir, an en page reaches siblings through ../ (0.065833ms)
✔ the active segment still tracks the locale when englishDir is set (0.443709ms)
✔ no --site resolves to repo root with no englishDir (0.084125ms)
✔ --site with an en/ subdirectory sources from it (0.090417ms)
✔ --site without an en/ subdirectory sources from the site root (0.07025ms)
ℹ tests 8
ℹ pass 8
ℹ fail 0
```

All 8 pass.

## Step 5 — the other three CLIs

- `tools/extract-i18n.js`: CLI block now calls
  `resolveSite(process.argv.slice(2))` for `rootDir`/`i18nDir`, and the page
  loop reads `*.html` from `rootDir` instead of iterating
  `DEFAULT_PROTOTYPE_PAGES`.
- `tools/check-i18n.js`: added a `--site` branch at the top of the existing
  arg-parsing `if/else if` chain, setting `srcDir`/`genDir`/`i18nDir`/`pages`
  from `resolveSite`. `tools/validate-catalogs.js` was left untouched per the
  brief (it already accepts a directory argument).
- `tools/build-video-i18n.js`: CLI block now supports `--src`, `--out`,
  `--i18n` flags via a small `flag()` helper (`path.resolve` on the arg,
  fallback otherwise), computing `outDir` from `outBase` + a locale-suffixed
  basename derived from `srcDir` (stripping a trailing `-en` if present). With
  no flags, `srcDir`/`outBase`/`i18nDir` resolve to the same defaults as
  before (`tutorial-video`, repo root, `i18n`), so ministry behaviour is
  unchanged.

## Step 6 — full suite + ministry-freeze proof

Ran, in order:
```
npm test
npm run i18n:build
npm run i18n:check
npm run video:build:fr
npm run video:build:es
git status --porcelain fr/ es/ tutorial-video-fr/ tutorial-video-es/
```

- `npm test`: **178/178 pass**, 0 fail (up from 175 before this task's 3 new
  `resolveSite` tests — the other 175 include the 5 `rewriteToggleLinks`
  tests from Task 1).
- `npm run i18n:build`: `Compiling i18n trees for . ...` / `✓ Generated 22
  pages across [fr, es].` — 11 pages × 2 locales, same count as the old
  hardcoded-list build. The new `*.html`-glob-based page discovery at the
  ministry root produced the identical 11-file sorted list (already verified
  by Task 1's author before this task started).
- `npm run i18n:check`: **1540/1540 (100%)** across fr and es — all 11 pages
  fully covered, no untranslated-string gaps.
- `npm run video:build:fr` / `npm run video:build:es`: each reported `8
  compositions, 3 assets copied`, matching pre-existing output.
- Final `git status --porcelain fr/ es/ tutorial-video-fr/
  tutorial-video-es/`: **empty output** — no tracked file in any of the four
  frozen trees changed.

### One wrinkle investigated and resolved (not a regression)

Running `npm run video:build:fr && npm run video:build:es` deletes and
recreates the entire `tutorial-video-{fr,es}/` output directory
(`buildVideoLocale` does `fs.rmSync(outDir, { recursive: true, force: true
})` at tools/build-video-i18n.js:61). That directory happens to also contain
a tracked `renders/` subfolder (pre-rendered `.mp4`/`.poster.jpg` files) that
the build script does not regenerate, so a straight rebuild shows those files
as deleted in `git status`.

I verified this is **pre-existing behavior unrelated to Task 2**: I stashed
all Task 2 changes, reverted to commit `8d66215` (Task 1's HEAD), ran the
same `video:build:fr`/`video:build:es` commands with the *old* code, and got
the identical deletion of the same four render files. The `outDir` path
computation for the no-flag case is byte-identical before and after Task 2
(`path.join(root, 'tutorial-video-fr')` either way), so nothing in this
task's diff caused or changed this behavior.

After confirming this, I restored the four render files with
`git checkout -- tutorial-video-fr/renders tutorial-video-es/renders` before
taking the final ministry-freeze snapshot above, which is why that final
`git status --porcelain` is empty. This is worth flagging to the team as a
pre-existing rebuild hazard for anyone re-running the video build locally
(unrelated to this task's scope, not fixed here).

## Step 7 — npm scripts

Added to `package.json` `scripts` exactly as specified:
```json
"org:build": "node tools/build-i18n.js --site pan-african-org",
"org:check": "node tools/check-i18n.js --site pan-african-org",
"org:extract": "node tools/extract-i18n.js --site pan-african-org",
"org:validate": "node tools/validate-catalogs.js pan-african-org/i18n",
"org:video:build:fr": "node tools/build-video-i18n.js fr --src pan-african-org/video-en --out pan-african-org --i18n pan-african-org/i18n",
"org:video:build:es": "node tools/build-video-i18n.js es --src pan-african-org/video-en --out pan-african-org --i18n pan-african-org/i18n"
```

Sanity-checked `org:build`, `org:check`, `org:extract` against the (currently
empty) `pan-african-org/en/` — each ran cleanly with 0 pages / 0 strings /
100% coverage, with no crashes. I then deleted the resulting scratch output
(`pan-african-org/fr/`, `pan-african-org/es/`, and the two empty catalog
skeleton files `common.{fr,es}.json`) so the committed `pan-african-org/`
tree contains only the two `.gitkeep` placeholders Task 3 expects to build
on, per the brief's sequencing note.

## Step 8 — commit

```
git add tools/ package.json tests/site-config.test.js pan-african-org/
git commit -m "feat(i18n): add --site flag for multi-site builds"
```

Commit `a98e285`, 8 files changed (91 insertions, 23 deletions):
`package.json`, `pan-african-org/en/.gitkeep` (new),
`pan-african-org/i18n/.gitkeep` (new), `tests/site-config.test.js`,
`tools/build-i18n.js`, `tools/build-video-i18n.js`, `tools/check-i18n.js`,
`tools/extract-i18n.js`.

Pre-existing untracked scratch files in the working tree (`fix.js`,
`pr_results.json`, `quality_*.json`, `review.md`,
`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-18-*.md`, `tutorial-video/snapshots/`, etc.)
were left untouched and unstaged — out of scope for this task.

## Concerns / follow-ups for later tasks

1. The video-build render-deletion wrinkle above is real and will resurface
   whenever `video:build:fr`/`video:build:es` (or the new
   `org:video:build:*` scripts) are rerun after renders exist. It predates
   this task and is out of scope to fix here, but Task 3 (or whoever renders
   the pan-African videos) should be aware `fs.rmSync(outDir, {recursive:
   true})` will nuke any `renders/` subfolder placed under the same
   `outDir`.
2. `pan-african-org/en/` and `pan-african-org/i18n/` currently contain only
   `.gitkeep` — Task 3 is expected to remove `en/.gitkeep` when it adds real
   pages, as noted in the task brief's sequencing note.
